summary.en: One sentence: what the work was, for whom, and what it had to achieve.
summary.zh-Hant: 一句話說明：這份工作是甚麼、為誰而做、要達成甚麼。
summary.zh-Hans: 一句话说明：这份工作是什么、为谁而做、要达成什么。

note.en: Where the figure came from, or what it was measured against.
note.zh-Hant: 數字的來源，或量度基準。
note.zh-Hans: 数字的来源，或量度基准。

scope.en: What was delivered — one line per deliverable.
scope.zh-Hant: 交付了甚麼——每一行一項。
scope.zh-Hans: 交付了什么——每一行一项。

alt.en: Mock-up: what the picture shows, described plainly.
alt.zh-Hant: 樣機：平實描述圖片內容。
alt.zh-Hans: 样机：平实描述图片内容。
